_meta.method: web_fetch + image URL pattern probing (curl HEAD checks)
notes: Levitaz product pages render full description content ONLY for the canonical variant; other size variants return blank detail sections (JS-rendered).

Per-size descriptions were extracted from the canonical-variant page; for other sizes the description body is shared (same product page) but spec table changes with size - spec tables for non-canonical sizes were NOT scraped (would require headless browser).
Image URLs were validated by curl HTTP status (200=OK, 302=redirect/missing).
Prices listed are Levitaz HQ EUR (excl. 20% VAT) as displayed on levitaz.com 2026-06-05.
Currency lock: Levitaz=EUR (KRW 1,800 per EUR per Danny brand currency lock).

PARTIAL DATA WARNING: per-size spec tables (Span/Area/AR for FW 680/790/900; Length/Thickness for Mast 84/96) were not extractable via HTML - only FW 540 + Mast 76 + STAB 180 specs are confirmed. Other size specs marked 'not found'.

free_series_fw_540.title: Free Series Front Wing - FW 540

Lift-to-drag ratio optimized for its specific application
Designed for kite, wing, and big wave surf use
construction_highlights: Integrated titanium interface for a play-free fit and ultra-precise power transfer
Pressed into the front wing during lamination for a permanent, ultra-stiff bond in the system's most highly loaded area
All main connection threads are located in titanium for reduced wear, easier maintenance, and long-term durability
Corrosion-resistant construction for reliable use in saltwater environments
One-tool system: all key connections on the hydrofoil setup and board use the same T30 Torx tool

r6_race_series_set_v1_mast_v1.tagline: Elevate Your Race with the Next Generation of Hydrofoil Technology
r6_race_series_set_v1_mast_v1.description: The Levitaz R6 Race Series marks a revolutionary leap in hydrofoil racing, succeeding the renowned R5 Race Series. Designed for superior performance and control, the R6 Race Series sets a new benchmark in competitive hydrofoiling. The R6 V1 set comes with the R6 V1 mast, which is characterized by exceptional stiffness, perfect for rough conditions or heavier riders needing a direct and responsive feel from their glider.
performance_features: Enhanced Acceleration and Low Wind Performance: increased acceleration and improved low-wind capabilities for varied conditions.
Superior Upwind and Downwind VMG: optimized lift/drag ratio guarantees highest Velocity Made Good (VMG) for upwind and downwind courses.
Smooth Running: flexing wings ensure a stable ride, effectively dampening turbulences.
Insensitive Wingtip Breaching: maintain control and performance even when wingtips breach the surface.
Superior Glide in Maneuvers: excellent controlled gliding during tacks and jibes for precise and confident navigation.
Focused Competition: R6's intuitive control lets riders push hard while staying fully focused on the race.
construction_features: Intelligent mix of material: unique stainless-steel box is the heart of the foil and sets a new benchmark for stiffness, accuracy of fit and durability.

Integrated trimming system: adjust angle of incidence (AOI) to personal preference and conditions without disassembling any part. AOI tuning possible even on-water between races. Adapt to weight, board model/scoop-rocker-line, foot strap and box position, riding conditions.
